RSS feed Print this page Receiving notifications of judgments of public interest and judicial announcements See the Courts of New Zealand home page for all recent judgments of public interest. In addition, you can receive notifications about judgments of public interest, case synopses, and court announcements published on the Courts of NZ website in the following ways: For judgment publication Subscribe to the Courts of NZ judgments of public interest subscription service and receive judgments of public interest in your email inbox. Follow Courts of New Zealand on Bluesky The Courts of New Zealand home page features all recent judgments of public interest. Supreme Court judgments, case synopses, media releases and announcements – will be notified on LinkedIn For court and judicial announcements LinkedIn Bluesky The Courts of New Zealand X account is no longer active. Posts made before 23 March 2025 remain on that platform and are available here .
